en: A vintage postcard shows an ornate, historical building with a large clock tower in a grand architectural style, likely late 19th or early 20th century. The text 'Danzig. Hauptbahnhof.' is printed at the top in a decorative script. There are horse-drawn carriages and people in early 20th-century attire, indicating the era. Architectural details are elaborate, with towers and statues visible.
